author: phase1a-v3-rereview-repair-lane
role: Closed proof records validated against a separately supplied immutable Run-sealed C2 activation authority; pure policy-ir-2 applies exact waiver suppression before baseline classification.
supersedesProofObligationsOf: artifacts/evaluation-proof.v2.json (preserved accepted predecessor with RR residuals)

repairs.mechanism: policy-ir-2 waiver-before-baseline order + overlap golden + inverse mutation

canonicalCommitmentGrammar.records: 0x10 member; 0x11 outcome; 0x12 waiver; 0x13 subject; 0x18 activation manifest; 0x19 activation member; every component separately framed
canonicalCommitmentGrammar.ordering: deduplicate exact record bytes then sort unsigned bytewise ascending

proofObligationsByClaimShape.local-match: typed subject plus at least one retained factRef
proofObligationsByClaimShape.relationship-match: typed relation semantics plus at least one retraceable witness edge and factRef
proofObligationsByClaimShape.aggregate-match: typed exact member-set commitment/count, retained partition, fold and facts
proofObligationsByClaimShape.no-match: typed exact subject-set commitment/count and retained fact partition
proofObligationsByClaimShape.indeterminate: typed resolvable reason; never absorbed into pass
proofObligationsByClaimShape.error: typed resolvable reason; never absorbed into pass

invariants.assert: Local and other retained claims carry concrete content references; booleans cannot stand for material.
Outcome, claimShape and proof tag form one exact closed union.
Every evaluation retains typed historical predicate semantics.
Subject/member sets and counts independently recompute from retained partitions.
The outcome commitment covers every exact activated tuple.
Coverage, baseline, waiver and policy inputs are typed, closed and content-addressed.
policy-ir-2 deterministically derives the persisted verdict; labels and coordinated policy edits are not trusted.
Typed component frames make tuple bytes injective; exact grammars reject control characters before persistence.
Every direct/transitive reference resolves once in one ProjectId graph; cycles, injection and unused objects reject.
requiredUniverse.memberIds exactly equals the sorted activated member set and its commitment.
Every persisted proof record and enum is recursively closed and type checked.
The exact activated universe comes only from a separately supplied immutable Run-sealed SealedEvaluationAuthorityV1 whose closed manifest bytes/ref and C2 commitment join independently recompute.
policy-ir-2 has one committed order: indeterminate dominates, exact waivers suppress current matches, then only effective matches are classified against baseline.

positiveVectors.why: relationship witness; unbaselined match derives fail
baseline identity and exact match set remain load-bearing; baselined match derives advisory
aggregate set recomputes and a typed exact waiver suppresses the only match
concrete retention seed: complete no-match with verifiable and replayable transitive dependency closure
typed indeterminate outcome forces indeterminate policy outcome
typed error outcome forces indeterminate policy outcome
baseline-plus-waiver overlap golden: exact waiver suppression happens before baseline classification, leaving no effective match and therefore pass

adversarialNegatives.why: relationship proof changed to another union tag
same count but wrong subject-set commitment
R8 member delimiter tuple is rejected before persistence; collision control proves v2 bytes also differ
R8 outcome delimiter component is rejected; collision control proves framed bytes differ
R8-P1A-P03 unknown outcome/shape/proof cannot bypass dispatch
coordinated arbitrary policy and pass label
coordinated local substitution and recomputation cannot replace immutable Run-sealed activation authority
baseline-before-waiver classification contradicts the only normative ordered policy program

decisionDependencies.supplies: exact activation and Coverage identity; policy-evaluation remains a no-effect pure-core stage
CoreCompletion.policyOutcome ownership and deterministic pure-core boundary
transitive dependency custody and capability availability

assurance.why: Closed artifacts and mutation tests are design-integrity evidence only. They do not qualify a product implementation or storage engine.

knownLimitations: Activation manifest construction and immutable Run sealing are specified and executable as pure validation but not demonstrated in a production host.
A1-RTV4-02 runtime overhead and scale remain unmeasured.
Independent rereview is required; this authoring candidate cannot accept itself or apply integration state.
sealRecommendation: DO NOT SEAL. RR-01/RR-02 repairs require independent rereview; runtime authority construction remains IMPLEMENTABLE_UNEXECUTED.

policySemanticsV2.hostRule: The host seals the core-returned policyOutcome and MUST NOT rederive a different verdict. Independent readers replay these same pure semantics to verify it.
policySemanticsV2.baselineRule: Classify only effective matches remaining after exact waiver suppression; an effective baseline match is advisory.
policySemanticsV2.waiverRule: Validate exact content-addressed waivers, then suppress each targeted current match before any baseline classification.

activationAuthority.trustedInputRule: authority is supplied separately from EvidenceBundle and producer-controlled fields
activationAuthority.hostDerivation: host derives the manifest from the admitted C2 ExecutionPlan plus resolved rule/predicate/policy activation graph
activationAuthority.runSealBinding: activationManifestRef is sealed into the immutable Run before EvidenceBundle validation
activationAuthority.producerAuthority: NONE; no implementer-selected activation or bundle-local universe can become authority
